scripts.routine:status: launchctl list | grep -F code-optimization-proposals || echo 'not loaded -- no scheduler job registered'
scripts.routine:start: plist=$(ls "$HOME"/Library/LaunchAgents/com.opencode.job.*.code-optimization-proposals.plist 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$plist" ] && launchctl bootstrap "gui/$(id -u)" "$plist" 2>/dev/null; launchctl list | grep -qF code-optimization-proposals && echo 'job loaded -- runs hourly at :00' || echo 'not loaded -- no plist found; create it with the opencode-scheduler plugin'
scripts.routine:stop: plist=$(ls "$HOME"/Library/LaunchAgents/com.opencode.job.*.code-optimization-proposals.plist 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$plist" ] && launchctl bootout "gui/$(id -u)/$(basename "$plist" .plist)" 2>/dev/null; launchctl list | grep -qF code-optimization-proposals && echo 'still loaded -- stop failed' || echo 'job unloaded'
scripts.routine:run: plist=$(ls "$HOME"/Library/LaunchAgents/com.opencode.job.*.code-optimization-proposals.plist 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$plist" ] && launchctl kickstart -p "gui/$(id -u)/$(basename "$plist" .plist)" && echo 'job triggered -- follow with: pnpm routine:logs' || echo 'no plist found'
scripts.routine:logs: log=$(ls "$HOME"/.config/opencode/logs/scheduler/*/code-optimization-proposals.log 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$log" ] && tail -f "$log" || echo 'no log yet -- the job has not run'
